finalText:
Perfect! I now have all the information I need from RFC 9110. Let me compile the results based on what I found in the specification.

From the HTTP Semantics specification (RFC 9110), I found all the required information for each status code. The specification explicitly lists which status codes are heuristically cacheable in Section 15.1:

"Responses with status codes that are defined as heuristically cacheable (e.g., 200, 203, 204, 206, 300, 301, 308, 404, 405, 410, 414, and 501 in this specification) can be reused by a cache with heuristic expiration unless otherwise indicated by the method definition or explicit cache controls."
